Pattern: Ines's mug location.
Assumption: I relied on the last known location (sink_k1) or guessed based on time of day.
Reality: On day 17, it was at sink_k1 at 08:12, but moved to coffee_table_l1 by 11:06. It is highly volatile, moving between kitchen and living room unpredictably.
Correction: Do not assume stability. If the last confirmed location is older than 2-3 hours, ABSTAIN. Do not guess based on time of day or previous room.

Pattern: Ines's book location.
Assumption: I assumed the book stayed in the living room (couch_l1 or coffee_table_l1) throughout the day.
Reality: On day 17, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 09:00, but moved to couch_l1 by 20:19. It shifts between these two spots.
Correction: Track the specific spot, not just the room. If the last known spot is older than a few hours, ABSTAIN. Do not default to one specific living room spot without recent confirmation.

Pattern: Ines's water bottle location.
Assumption: I guessed dish_rack_k1 based on kitchen proximity.
Reality: On day 17, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 11:16. It does not consistently stay in the kitchen.
Correction: Check coffee_table_l1 for daytime/evening hours. Do not default to kitchen spots without recent confirmation. If unsure, ABSTAIN.

Pattern: Ines's glass location.
Assumption: I guessed sink_k1, assuming it was being washed or stored in the kitchen.
Reality: On day 17, it was at nightstand_b1 at 22:09. It moves to the bedroom at night.
Correction: For late evening/night, check nightstand_b1. Do not default to kitchen spots. If the last known location is not in the bedroom and it is late, ABSTAIN or check bedroom spots.

General Rule: Ines's items are highly mobile. Strict recency is required. If the last confirmed location is older than 3-4 hours, ABSTAIN. Do not extrapolate based on time of day or room habits.
